home.lead: Live crowd levels, wait times and short-term forecasts for the canteen, library, print shop and every campus hotspot — so you go when it’s quiet, not when it’s packed.
home.bestBetsSub: Open, quiet and staying that way for the next hour.
home.headsUpSub: Predicted peaks in the next three hours.
home.noAlerts: No big rushes expected in the next three hours.
home.step1Text: Anonymous Wi-Fi association counts from each building’s access points, plus one-tap crowd reports from people already there.
home.step2Text: A seasonal model learned from weeks of history, adjusted for exam and deadline days, predicts the next three hours with an uncertainty band.
home.step3Text: Check before you leave class. Pick the quiet slot, get an alert when your spot clears, skip the queue.

about.title: About Rushcast
about.problemText: Students and staff walk to the canteen, library or print shop only to find it packed, or closed. Long unpredictable waits, no seats, and daily micro-stress between tight lecture slots.
about.fixText: A real-time predictive dashboard that shows crowd levels and wait times for every hotspot before you leave class, and forecasts the next three hours so you can pick a quieter slot or a quieter place.
about.dataText: Wi-Fi access-point association counts (aggregated, no MACs), headcount calibration, and anonymous one-tap reports in Postgres.
about.processingText: Python pipeline in GitHub Actions: seasonal weekday × 15-min profile, academic-calendar multipliers, conformal uncertainty band, backtested every run.
about.presentationText: Installable web app (PWA) with live updates, a color-coded campus map, forecasts, alerts and six languages.
about.privacyText: Only counts per building leave the network. No names, no MAC addresses, no location tracking. Crowd reports carry a random install ID that never leaves the database.
about.teamText: Built for Ick-a-thon 2026, Problem Statement 1: Campus & Facility Crowd Predictor.
about.demoText: This deployment runs on a realistic simulation of campus Wi-Fi telemetry so it works anywhere. Connect a free Supabase project to switch to live reports and sensor readings.
about.liveText: Connected to the live database. Reports and sensor readings stream in real time.
